items.prompt:
Which group of words is a complete sentence?
A) 'The rabbit hopped across the yard.'
B) 'The rabbit across the yard.'
items.answer: A) 'The rabbit hopped across the yard.'

steps: A has a subject (The rabbit) and a predicate with a verb (hopped across the yard). Complete sentence.
B has a subject and a phrase but no verb — what did the rabbit do? Fragment.
